nvitk.pipes.bbtpy.util.bb_vessel_segmentation¶

Black-blood lumen segmentation from warped eICAB labels.

Per vessel: dilate the eICAB label on vwi_bb, estimate a hypointense threshold from intensities inside that dilated ROI only, and paste wvi < threshold voxels into seg_bb. No region growing.
